upg_sparkle.description: one centered four-point warm-white sparkle, long narrow elegant rays and small soft golden glow, a crisp luminous core, radial falloff

upg_dust.description: one soft light warm-gray construction dust puff, organic wispy cloudy silhouette, subtle soft tan variation, no hard rim, airy translucent outer falloff

upg_confetti.description: exactly three small paper confetti pieces grouped near center, one blue #3D7BFF, one gold #FFC93C, one violet #7C4DFF, slight folded curls, clearly separated, minimal soft shading

upg_ray.description: one centered vertical luminous white beam with pale cyan core, narrow at top, softly widening toward bottom, smooth intensity gradient along its length, feathered edges, no floor or halo

upg_ring.description: one thin clean circular white expanding shockwave ring seen straight on, perfectly round and centered, hollow completely transparent center, softly feathered thin rim, extremely faint pale cyan glow
